standard_question: How long is the smart-home hub warranty?
similar_questions: How long is the warranty period
answers: Full device warranty 24 months, battery accessories 12 months. Damage from disassembly or water ingress is not covered.

standard_question: Does voice control still work after losing internet?
similar_questions: Can I control by voice without internet
answers: If voice recognition runs in the cloud, only the app and local touchscreen work after losing internet; basic commands keep working once a local voice pack is installed.

standard_question: How many hubs can one account bind?
answers: Personal edition: up to 3 hubs; Enterprise edition: per contract, 50 by default.

standard_question: What is the hotel reimbursement cap for first-tier cities?
answers: First-tier cities (Beijing/Shanghai/Guangzhou/Shenzhen): up to 600 CNY/night (tax incl.); any excess is paid personally.

standard_question: How do I claim meal expenses on business trips?
answers: Meals during business trips are not reimbursed separately; you receive a per-day travel allowance of 150 CNY/day in first-tier cities and 120 CNY/day elsewhere.

standard_question: When will the Q1 knowledge-base POC go live?
similar_questions: When is the after-sales KB accepted
answers: Target: internal demo by 2024-03-01, technical delivery led by Zhang Ming.

standard_question: Who is responsible for the after-sales KB POC?
answers: Technical lead: Zhang Ming (R&D); product contact: Li Wei; QA lead: Zhao Lei.

standard_question: Which protocols does Hub Pro support?
similar_questions: Which smart-device protocols can it connect
answers: Supports Matter, Zigbee 3.0, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth Mesh; firmware 3.5 is planned to complete Matter 1.2 certification.

standard_question: How many annual-leave days does 10 years of service get?
similar_questions: Annual leave after ten years of service
Leave days by years of service
answers: 1-10 years of service: 10 days; over 10 years: 15 days; calculated from the hire date.

standard_question: When will Matter certification be completed?
answers: Planned to release firmware 3.5 as a gray rollout by end of March 2024 and complete Matter 1.2 certification.
